oracle.ref: PR #1460 (feat); fix evidence: PR 1460; on stand wo3 (19/10/2026) builds kept ja-restaurant 13→4, ja-vega 17→2, ja-spa 7→2, tracy-base 6→2 pages because pagesOf used the brief's 3–5 page sitemap as the keep list; E2E on stand wobrief 19/10/2026 (ja-restaurant j6 kept exactly 8, 5 unpublished; Tracy Base j6 lost resources/contact before e539649ea1); EmDash Tracy Base hand-off on wobrief: Home/Menu/Services/Blog/About all restaurant content, /pricing 404
oracle.invariant: S1: ja-restaurant keeps 8 of 13 pages (one menu layout, one contact page, no sample pages), Tracy Base keeps 6 of 6 on EmDash (pricing kept with its layout since 26/10/2026) and 10 of 23 on Joomla, its Contact under Resources kept; every page taken off has a reason; the menu holds dishes, never a job advert, a match night or a joke; a past event or offer goes only to events/offers. S2: footers, feed bait and keyword lists are cut; a post said twice is one item unless its numbers differ; job adverts, giveaways, closures, greetings and other-language posts are left out; when an event runs comes from its words, a weekly night is unknown, never active. S3: pages answered = the plan's kept pages (no answer when all are kept); the brief has content items and is valid; the menu page shows the restaurant's posted dishes on the site (fill 'dishes') with or without a menu link, never a button to the live menu, and with no posts it is fill 'dishes' with no items.

assertionIds: a template keeps its pages: one of each kind, without the samples and variants a demo ships
every page taken off says why
on real feeds the menu shows dishes, never a job advert, a match night or a joke
a past event or offer is never a dish, a story or a blog post; the menu takes posts about food, not about a match night
the footer a page repeats under its posts is cut from every body, and its links are kept as evidence
two posts alike in words but not in their date, price or place stay two items
a job advert, a giveaway or a contest is never content
when an event or an offer runs is read from its words, never from the day it was posted
a pricing page keeps its layout: neutral without a collected price, the collected prices when the brief has them
a page is known by its own name before its section: Contact under Resources is the contact page
a menu page shows the restaurant’s dishes on the site, with or without a menu link; never a button to the live menu
a history page without an about page starts from the best story; a gallery without photographs comes off
an EmDash page carries no path: its id is not always its route (services_page is served at /services)
